newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Fires destroy two shops in Bahrain, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Fires destroy two shops in Bahrain, no casualties.

text.p: Fires gutted a supermarket and a shop in Bahrain over the weekend but there were no reports of casualties, a local newspaper said on Sunday.
The daily Akhbar al-Khaleej said the two fires were in Isa town, eight km (five miles) south of the capital Manama. Government officials were unavailable for comment.

It was not immediately clear whether the fires were connected with anti-government protests waged by the island's majority Shi'ite Moslem community since December 1994 to press for economic and political reforms.
Six Asian workers died in two separate fires in Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking hub, in June and July.
A government official previously described a series of arson attacks in the Gulf Arab state as continued acts of terrorism.
